problem_statement: ZMS reports the wrong amount of free space. zms_calc_free_space() and zms_active_sector_free_space() return incorrect values: they can return a negative result (which is misinterpreted as an error code), they overcount the free space by one ATE per sector, they count more than one ATE belonging to the same ID that is stored in the same sector (only the most recent entry should be counted), and they apply a space-correction term in the wrong place and to the wrong sectors. As a result, callers cannot rely on these functions to tell how many bytes can still be written without triggering garbage collection, or whether the storage is full. The functions must return the true non-negative number of writable bytes for an active sector and the total filesystem, accounting correctly for header ATEs, the reserved delete ATE, small data stored inside ATEs, and closed sectors.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/fs/zms -s tests/subsys/fs/zms/filesystem.zms -s filesystem.zms -O twister-out --no-clean -W
